findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_topup_requirements, list_webhooks, create_subscription, get_delivery_log, read_events · Private data: get_account, get_topup_requirements, add_webhook · Public sink: get_topup_requirements, list_webhooks, add_webhook, remove_webhook, create_subscription, read_events · Destructive: remove_webhook, remove_subscription.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_topup_requirements, list_webhooks, create_subscription, get_delivery_log, read_events · Private data: get_account, get_topup_requirements, add_webhook · Public sink: get_topup_requirements, list_webhooks, add_webhook, remove_webhook, create_subscription, read_events · Destructive: remove_webhook, remove_subscription

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
